title: Gateway Overview & Enabling
desc: Use Studio as an external TTS backend over HTTP.
lede: The gateway turns Studio into a local text-to-speech backend your own tools can call over HTTP, using the engines you've installed.
body:
At a glance
  • A local HTTP API for synthesis.
  • Enable it in Settings.
  • OpenAPI docs at /api/v1/tts/docs.

What the gateway is

It exposes synthesis over HTTP so scripts and apps can generate speech through Studio's installed engines — no cloud account needed.

Enabling it

Turn the gateway on in Settings. It's off by default. Once enabled, the interactive OpenAPI docs are served at /api/v1/tts/docs.

Note — This is for an AI/automation audience — the endpoint pages are precise enough to hand to your own assistant to integrate.
